friction_events.description: A durable Guide receipt used consumed_returns.return_ref, which the CURRENT compiler ignored, so the same integration trigger resurfaced until a compiler-compatible .ref receipt was persisted.
The alias-compat source repair required repository_test_runtime, but this worker had no repository checkout/network runtime and did not apply an untested whole-file replacement.
José V11 source recovery and downstream candidate publication were routed beyond their embedded fixed-generation gates without new dependency evidence.
A fixed-G1 contention canary whose barrier deadline expired on 2026-09-17 was exposed as READY on 2026-10-02 and could be atomically claimed before post-claim validation saw the expiry.
Live allocator projections lagged main policy commits; verification was deferred until the projection source_sha matched the exact policy commit.
The public exit URL fetch returned a cache miss, so the exact gh-pages wc/exit/index.html artifact was read instead before close.

decision_trace.decision: Create a fresh v3.30 identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The launch envelope required a de-novo beacon and prohibited historical identity reuse.
decision_trace.action: Created the worker beacon, then loaded the compact frontier and claimed work.
decision_trace.outcome: Fresh worker identity and launch_nonce were durably bound before ownership.

decision_trace.decision: Use supported external recovery policies to stop stale fixed-generation retries.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The allocator loader consumes coordination/portfolio/recovery-policies and live projections can prove the resulting route.
decision_trace.action: Persisted platform-wake and José source-recovery policies, then verified allocator source_sha and attention fields.
decision_trace.outcome: Platform wake is fixed at generation 3 and José source recovery at generation 6 with ordinary retries suppressed.

decision_trace.decision: Do not count or preserve a malformed Guide disposition as successful consumption.
decision_trace.observable_basis: A fresh frontier repeated the Integrator after a receipt using return_ref, and allocator source accepts string/ref/path only.
decision_trace.action: Persisted a compiler-compatible .ref disposition and materialized a bounded parser-compat successor through semantic dedup.
decision_trace.outcome: Immediate repeated returns were consumed; generic parser repair remains assigned to repository_test_runtime.

decision_trace.decision: Abort stale José recovery/publication generations rather than replay exhausted work.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Post-claim capsules fixed source recovery at G6 and publication at G3, with no required new source/dependency evidence present.
decision_trace.action: Returned ROUTE_ABORTED for G9/G4, then integrated each residual into a deduplicated external-gate successor.
decision_trace.outcome: Source recovery gate is live-verified; candidate-publication gate successor is durable and ready for execution.

decision_trace.decision: Treat the late contention PIN as defect evidence, not a valid race result.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The barrier deadline preceded this launch by about two weeks and the job requires entrants plus release before the deterministic PIN race.
decision_trace.action: Persisted ROUTE_ABORTED and created no fake contender, release or collision.
decision_trace.outcome: No false canary completion was asserted; expired-barrier READY leakage remains explicit debt.

decision_trace.decision: Close at the resident pool target instead of creating filler work.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Six evidence-backed productive slots are durable; v3.30 PROD-01 target is 6 and hard cap is 8.
decision_trace.action: Ran the universal exit audit and persisted E9 in the existing exam owner.
decision_trace.outcome: TARGET_REACHED with six productive units and residual debt explicitly bounded.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Accept return_ref as a sanitized alias when compiling Guide consumed_returns and retain ref/path/string behavior with regression coverage.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents false RETURNS_UNCONSUMED repeats from valid durable receipts.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Compile embedded derived-job recovery_policy into the CURRENT external recovery-policy semantics or fail closed when the two disagree.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Prevents workers from claiming stale G+1 generations whose own capsules already forbid ordinary retry.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Filter expired contention barriers before emitting READY fixed-generation PIN candidates.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Avoids late ownership that can never satisfy rendezvous acceptance and preserves the deterministic race fixture.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 PROD-01 worker reached 6/6 productive units. It live-verified two fixed-generation recovery gates, repaired immediate Guide return consumption, materialized three deduplicated residual jobs, and refused stale or expired claims as successes. Remaining debt is bounded to a parser regression requiring repository_test_runtime, one unexecuted candidate-publication gate, expired-barrier preclaim suppression, and the genuinely missing exact José V11 source evidence.
